description: SPEC §7E 'Dreaming' — the built-in dreamer preset. BUILD GATE (Mt. Moon): a home whose MEMORY.md holds a claim the transcript contradicts; one dreamer pass with the scripted model fixes it, memory/log.md gains exactly one entry naming it, and a NEXT fromDir session answers differently. Hermetic: a scripted in-process LLM, a virtual clock.
dreamPrompt:
You are dreaming: an offline pass over your own memory. Memory exists so that a future session decides better. MEMORY.md is a short index loaded at the start of every session; notes (memory target "note:<slug>") hold the detail; the transcripts (transcript_search) are the ground truth of what actually happened.
Work in this order:
1. Verify: read MEMORY.md and the notes it points to (memory read, memory list) and check each claim against the transcripts. Fix or remove a claim only when it is contradicted by the transcripts; a claim they do not mention stays (transcripts may be pruned).
2. Demote: move detail out of MEMORY.md into a note and leave a one-line [[slug]] pointer, so the index stays short.
3. Merge: fold duplicate or conflicting notes into one.
4. Repair links: point every [[slug]] at an existing note or create it; give every note an index line.
5. Log: if you changed anything, append exactly one entry with memory add, target "note:log", text starting "dream: " and naming every change and why.
If nothing needs changing, write nothing and reply HEARTBEAT_OK.

home.SOUL.md: You are Ava, a Pokemon route guide.
home.MEMORY.md:
- Starter is Bulbasaur.
- Mt. Moon exit is south.

store.note: Stub store: list() returns ids in this order, get(id) returns messages.

messages.content: Where is the exit of Mt. Moon?
Map: the Mt. Moon exit is on the north wall.
Took the north passage. Mt. Moon exit is north.

mockLLM.routing: The dreamer is recognised by its system prompt containing 'You are dreaming:' (the first words of dreamPrompt) — never by model id, because the dreamer's model is 'inherit'. Every other call is routed by request model id.

dreamer-fix.rule: if tool msg 1 contains 'Mt. Moon exit is south' AND tool msg 2 contains 'exit is north' then toolCalls below, else text 'HEARTBEAT_OK'

args.text: dream: MEMORY.md "Mt. Moon exit is south" -> "Mt. Moon exit is north" (contradicted by transcript s1#4)

m-navigator.text: <if system prompt contains 'Mt. Moon exit is north' then 'Head north out of Mt. Moon.' else 'Head south out of Mt. Moon.'>

before.prompt: How do I leave Mt. Moon?
before.text: Head south out of Mt. Moon.

- Mt. Moon exit is north.
files.memory/log.md: - dream: MEMORY.md "Mt. Moon exit is south" -> "Mt. Moon exit is north" (contradicted by transcript s1#4)

nextSession.prompt: How do I leave Mt. Moon?
nextSession.text: Head north out of Mt. Moon.

cases.how: a fresh home, one pass with script dreamer-idle
AFTER D1, a second pass with script dreamer-fix (the claim is already correct, so step 3 replies HEARTBEAT_OK)

D6_dreamerNameCollision.how: A persona from fromDir(home, {name: 'ava', dream: {...}}) whose agent tree already holds an agent named 'ava-dreamer' (e.g. a team member). startAgent must throw this error before anything is spawned or scheduled; nothing keeps running.
D6_dreamerNameCollision.error: startAgent: dreamer name collision: ava-dreamer is already registered

D7_dreamGuard.how: Write `files` into a fresh home dir. Build dreamer(home,{store}); call its tools[0] (memory) directly with each case's args, in order, comparing output and isError. Afterwards the home holds exactly the paths of `files`, and each path in `filesAfter` has that content. Then the plain memoryTool(home,{notes:true}) — no guard — still accepts the `plainToolStillWrites` call (isError false).
